Check whether each proposed object fits the subject and requested relation; use relevant learned background facts when genuinely known, with unknown prior neutral. A patent action, employment relation, office, event and location are different roles; infer only distinctions supported by the question and context. Resolve supported contradictions without keeping an incompatible alternative. Preserve warranted complementary answers. Output minimal canonical objects and one short explanatory sentence.
